page.notes: Doubtful readings: "saris" (printed with a long s, possibly a misprint for "satis"); "perfici" in the left margin note; "ara" in the left margin note; the margin note reads as printed, with hyphens at line ends. The catchword "citra" stands at the foot right. The running head is set in small capitals and is given in capitals. The printed letters s and st are transcribed as s.
